{{Quote|Lieutenant, did the kidnappers see you?''"<br />"''No sir, we're the best scouts in the regiment.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to the [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF trooper]] [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]|audio=BestScoutsInRegiment-TCWf.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />}}
A '''clone trooper lieutenant''' who served as an [[Advanced Recon Force trooper/Legends|ARF trooper]] was tasked with tracking down [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] kidnapped [[Rotta/Legends|son]].

==Biography==
After Jabba the Hutt's son was kidnapped by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], they were sent to track down the kidnapped Hutt. After following hired bounty hunters that were contracted by Jabba the Hutt, they and their squad discovered that the Hutt was sent to a [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr Order]] [[B'omarr Monastery|monastery]] on the planet of [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. They contacted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and told them that the monastery was too heavily fortified for their squad to go in alone.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />

Afterward, once Jedi General [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] fleet entered the Teth system, they reported to General Skywalker that there were at least two droid battalions protecting the monastery, and that he would not be able to land there.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />

==Equipment==
They wore a suit of light-weight recon armor made of plastoid material, equipped with surveillance gear. Their armor was camouflaged to blend in with the environment of the planet Teth.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] was referred to by Mace Windu as "Commander". In the DVD's subtitles, this lieutenant's line is erroneously attributed to [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].
